abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions track the app's real variation well and an Items section (scenario 4) would reuse nearly everything, only copying the small handler+page pair as intended; the deductions are the home page's parallel card-building and a couple of minor boolean flags.

findings.issue: Sprite URL is constructed inline here and in the server's spriteUrl helper, so a sprite bug fix (e.g. Deoxys-style default-variety sprites) must be applied in 2-3 places (also app/server/api/team.get.ts:53) instead of one
findings.suggestion: Move sprite URLs into the /api/species DTO (app/server/api/species.get.ts) or add a client-side spriteUrl helper in Nuxt 4's shared/utils/ so app and Nitro share one definition

findings.issue: Each page hand-declares an interface mirroring its server DTO (e.g. PokemonData mirrors app/server/api/pokemon/[name].get.ts), so every server shape change needs a parallel type edit or silently drifts
findings.suggestion: Define DTO interfaces once in shared/types/ (auto-imported by both app and server in Nuxt 4) and type the handlers against them

findings.issue: The generic Pokémon card component and CardList.vue:3 carry the ability-specific 'hidden' flag and 'Hidden ability' text, entangling the Abilities feature with shared card rendering
findings.suggestion: Render the hidden-ability note via a slot in CardList/PokemonCard, keeping the components feature-agnostic

findings.issue: humanize (and to a lesser degree spriteUrl) is duplicated between the server client and app/app/composables/format.ts:1, so formatting changes need two edits
findings.suggestion: Put humanize (and a spriteUrl helper) in shared/utils/ so both runtimes auto-import one implementation

findings.issue: The team page re-implements the card grid markup instead of using CardList, so any list-wide change (sorting, layout, card tweaks) misses it
findings.suggestion: Extend CardList with a per-item default slot (or an item footer slot) and use it here

findings.issue: English short_effect normalization ('.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() || latestFlavorText(...) || null') is copy-pasted in app/server/api/abilities/[name].get.ts:9-10, and would be copy-pasted again for an Items section
findings.suggestion: Extract an englishEffect() helper next to latestFlavorText in app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts

findings.issue: usePageData requires callers to invent unique cache keys manually (e.g. 'pokemon:${name}'), which is friction and risks silent collisions; Nuxt derives keys from the URL when omitted
findings.suggestion: Drop the key parameter or default it to the URL string inside usePageData

findings.issue: The type-label fallback 'labels[t] ?? humanize(t)' is repeated in four places across server handlers and pages
findings.suggestion: Add a small labelFor(labels, name) helper (or always ship complete label maps from the server) so the fallback rule lives once

summary: This is a genuinely maintainable Nuxt 4 codebase: per-page DTO handlers server-side, thin usePageData seam, and small props-only components, so most changes land in obvious places and the Moves-shaped extension point holds up well. The recurring cost is duplication across the server/client boundary — sprite URLs, humanize, and DTO types are each maintained in two places — and the ability feature leaks a hidden flag into the shared card components. Fixing the shared-boundary duplication (Nuxt 4's shared/ directory) would remove most of the remaining friction.
